workload.description: S4(x1,x2,x3, x(P1+P2+P3)) on a3-fast-32bit-p256class (p = 4294967291, a = -3, b = 31, prime order n = 4294959973, full group), planted x(P_i) <= p^delta, JM basic lattice l = 1 (dim 125), repo lll_reduce_hp, Lovasz 0.99

metric: trials with >= 3 reduced rows vanishing at the planted root over Z
note: 0/36 recoveries at delta = 0.035..0.125 (B = 2..15, 6 trials each), consistent with the l = 1 reach delta_1 = 0.00133 (X < 1.03 at 32 bits); l = 2 (dim 729, reach X < 2^0.46 at 32 bits) not run, too slow for the repo BigInt LLL.
